Sri Debabrata Sinha vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2
March, 2026
02.03.2026
28.
 Bd. Crr 635 of 2025
 Ct. 29

Sri Debabrata Sinha
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Saikat Mukherjee ... for the petitioner.

The petitioner herein has prayed for quashing of the proceeding being G.R. Case No. 2238 of 2020 under section 409/420 of the Indian Penal Code presently pending before learned Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Paschim Medinipur.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Paschim Medinipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Being aggrieved by the said proceeding learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the Director of Super Mill Pvt. Ltd. who executed bipartite agreement with the District Controller,
Food and Supplies, Paschim Medinipur for acceptance of paddy by the Food and Supplies Department at the Centralized Procurement Centre or Direct Purchase Camps and conversion of paddy into Custom Milled Rice (CMR) and delivery of the resultant rice in terms of CMR (Control and Obligation) order, 2017-2018.

It is alleged in the complaint that the quantum of paddy handled over to the rice mill concerned was 6824.594 MT and the quantity of CMR delivery by the Rice Mill was 4032.34 MT and that the petitioner has misappropriated the CMR to the tune of 608.38 MT amounting to Rs. 1,76,06,760/-.
It is submitted that thereafter the complainant sent a letter on 4th May, 2023 asking the petitioner to deposit an amount of Rs. 2,03,81,809/- which includes interest.

Petitioner submits that he has already paid aforesaid entire amount on 31st May, 2023 and therefore the contents of the present application does not attract any criminality and further continuance of the instant proceeding which has arisen out of contractual and commercial transaction will be a mere abuse of the process of the court.
Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the application is admitted.

Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of application upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the opposite party no. 2 through speed post intimating next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.
